title: Create an expense or income category
summary: Categories organize miscellaneous movements and define whether they're income or expense.

steps.title: Menu → Cashier → Product and Services Categories
Name
steps.details: Expense examples: Cleaning, Stationery, Shipping. Income: Partner contribution, Refunds.

steps.title: Code
steps.details: Short and unique, for reports (e.g. CLEAN).

steps.title: Type
steps.details: Expense: money goes out of the cash register. Income: it comes in. It can't be changed later if it already has movements.

steps.title: Active
steps.details: Only active ones are offered when recording a movement.
